proposals.action_title: Launch First 30-Page KDP Coloring Book in a Micro-Niche
proposals.why_this_works_now: Leverages the existing produce_coloring_book pipeline. By utilizing the free Together AI FLUX-schnell or Cloudflare API, Hugo can generate highly detailed line art without upfront image costs, targeting a specific micro-niche (e.g., 'French Countryside Gardens' or 'Steampunk Animals') to bypass high-competition keywords.
proposals.first_action_today: Configure TOGETHER_API_KEY in GitHub Actions, run the produce_coloring_book pipeline for 30 images, and compile them into a print-ready PDF using a simple Python script.

proposals.action_title: Bulk Upload 20 Sticker Packs to Redbubble
proposals.why_this_works_now: Redbubble organic traffic is highly receptive to sticker sheets/packs. By using produce_literal_idioms or produce_svg_pack, Hugo can generate transparent PNGs that require zero printing/shipping management. Packs offer higher perceived value than single stickers.
proposals.first_action_today: Run produce_literal_idioms_v2 to generate 20 transparent PNG designs on GitHub Actions, download them to his Android phone, and upload them as sticker sheets.

proposals.why_this_works_now: 3D printing hobbyists actively pay 1-3 EUR for functional, parametric STL files (boxes, grid wall hooks, cable organizers) that they can customize. The produce_stl_parametric pipeline generates these files programmatically with zero manual 3D modeling work required.
proposals.first_action_today: Run the produce_stl_parametric pipeline, generate 5 variations of a highly functional desk organizer, and list them on Cults3D at 1.49 EUR each.

proposals.action_title: List 3 Premade KDP Covers on Etsy as Digital Downloads
proposals.why_this_works_now: Self-publishers on a budget search Etsy for cheap, premade high-quality book covers (priced 10-20 EUR). Using the produce_kdp_cover pipeline, Hugo can generate striking covers, add editable text layers (or offer to edit the text for the buyer), and list them as digital files.
proposals.first_action_today: Generate 3 high-end sci-fi/thriller covers using the produce_kdp_cover pipeline, save them with placeholder text, and create Etsy digital listings.

proposals.action_title: Publish 2 Niche Gamedev UI/Sprite Packs on Itch.io
proposals.why_this_works_now: Game developers constantly need UI assets, button packs, or simple item icons. Itch.io has no listing fees, allows immediate publishing, and has a strong organic developer audience. Using produce_gamedev_asset_pack, Hugo can package simple assets into zip files.
proposals.first_action_today: Run the produce_gamedev_asset_pack pipeline to create a 'Retro Pixel UI Asset Pack' and upload it to itch.io under a 'Pay What You Want' model with a 2.00 EUR minimum.

proposals.action_title: Local French Pride T-Shirt Series on Redbubble
proposals.why_this_works_now: French regional pride (Brittany, Normandy, Savoy) generates highly targeted, passionate search traffic. By using the produce_chateau_local pipeline or simple text-based regional quotes, Hugo can capture hyper-local search intent with virtually zero competition.
proposals.first_action_today: Identify 5 popular French regional expressions, generate clean minimalist typography files using Termux, and upload them to Redbubble targeting French buyers.
